# JMIR Research Protocols

> Open-access, peer-reviewed journal publishing research protocols across health, eHealth, and medical research domains.

JMIR Research Protocols is part of JMIR Publications and indexed in PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science. The journal is led by Editor-in-Chief Amy Schwartz and focuses on registered reports, study protocols, and research methodology across eHealth and traditional research domains.

## Key Topics

- Research protocols
- Peer review
- Open-access publishing
- eHealth research
- Registered reports
- Article processing fees
- Impact factor
- Publication guidelines
- Research methodology
- Study protocols
- PubMed indexing
- JMIR Publications
- Academic publishing
- Grant proposals
- Preregistration

## About the Journal

- [JMIR Research Protocols](https://researchprotocols.org): Homepage for JMIR Research Protocols, open-access journal for peer-reviewed research protocols.
- [Focus and Scope](https://researchprotocols.org/about-journal/focus-and-scope): Journal scope and focus defining JMIR Research Protocols' mission and publication guidelines.
- [Editorial Board](https://researchprotocols.org/about-journal/editorial-board): Editorial board members including Editor-in-Chief Amy Schwartz and associate editors.
- [Indexing and Impact Factor](https://researchprotocols.org/about-journal/indexing-and-impact-factor): Journal indexing in PubMed, MEDLINE, and impact factor information.
- [Article Processing Fees](https://researchprotocols.org/about-journal/article-processing-fees): Article processing fees and publication cost information for JMIR Research Protocols.

## Author Guidelines and Resources

- [Instructions for Authors](https://researchprotocols.org/author-information/instructions-for-authors): Comprehensive guidelines for manuscript submission, peer review, and publication requirements.
- [Author Hub](https://researchprotocols.org/resource-centre/author-hub): Author resources hub with submission guidelines, formatting, and publishing fee information.

## Browse Content

- [Top Articles](https://researchprotocols.org/top-articles/overview): Top articles ranked by views, citations, and social media engagement metrics.
- [Themes](https://researchprotocols.org/themes): Themed research categories for browsing and organizing published protocols.
- [Non-Randomized Study Protocols and Methods (Non-eHealth)](https://researchprotocols.org/themes/97): Theme collection for non-randomized study protocols and research methodology.
- [Non-randomized Protocols and Methods (eHealth)](https://researchprotocols.org/themes/89): Theme collection for non-randomized eHealth protocols and digital health interventions.
- [Issues](https://researchprotocols.org/issues): Journal issue archives and publication volumes for historical content access.

## Partnerships and Publishing

- [Institutional Partners](https://researchprotocols.org/fees/institutional-partners): Institutional partnership programs and membership agreements for publishing fee discounts.
